verdict.rationale: A live runtime probe confirms Superset publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at https://api.superset.sh/openapi.json, titled 'Superset API' with a summary describing programmatic access to the agent-orchestration platform, backing the MCP server and TypeScript SDK described in the docs. Earlier probes for openapi.json under docs.superset.sh 404'd, but the correct live endpoint under api.superset.sh returns the spec successfully. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of using the spec directly (only first-party probe evidence).
